component.name: WeatherTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "run" end sub
sub run() port = CreateObject("roMessagePort") while true server = CreateObject("roRegistrySection", "tvui").Read("server") if server <> "" then http = CreateObject("roUrlTransfer") http.SetUrl(server + "/api/weather") body = http.GetToString() if body <> "" then data = ParseJson(body) if data <> invalid then m.top.result = data end if end if wait(10 * 60 * 1000, port) end while end sub
